m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I will peck your eyes out! B'caw, oh hey Wizard, you're back. Whatcha find?
Ah, the mythology of empire, I see. That oughtta do it. Even tells me which card we should create: the Emperor. So now we got the hard part.
Our new spell needs a shape and that shape needs fillin' with meaning. And both these here things need to be forged through action.
Hang on a sec there. Ahem. Caro et anima, aether et substantia, tarocchi et Spell Cards.
That there is some fancypants incantation what will mold your actions into a card. Probably. So let's start with the shape of our spell.
Iff'n the House of Swords makes the emperor, then I say Gargoyles should be our Emperor. Go give them a tussle, Wizard.
We are engaged in some very serious spellcrafting here after all.
Right, hmm, now the meaning behind the Emperor. Let's see... I think... I think...
Shoot, I don't know what it means to be an emperor. If only we knew one we could talk to.
By gum, Wizard, that's a humdinger of an idea. The MooShu emperor should be plenty willing to help. Go talk to him in the Jade Palace.
I am going to skedaddle from this here city; I swear I saw the locals prepping an air fryer.
My friend, you appear distraught, is everything well? I see. If telling you the ways of the emperor will help, then I will do what I can.
An emperor is many things, depending on who you ask. I would say an emperor is a servant, to a people, to a nation, to a world.
To rule with care and kindness, discipline and wisdom, that is the way of the Emperor. Yet, one cannot deny the inverse philosophy.
Many emperors are tyrants, ruling with fear and threats and bribery. Hmm, perhaps I can demonstrate both sides of empire in one task.
I have only just received word of a threat in distant Catmandu. Something left behind by the Stone of Heaven has risen and rallied an invasion force.
Travel to Catmandu, save my people, and see what it means to be an Emperor.
Help! Oh, help! This is an emergency! Someone please help!
Oh, are you here to help? Thank goodness. I've been yelling for days!
No, there's no time to explain! That's what I've been yelling about! Just go into the Yurt of Oppression and stop the golden horse man!
HURRY!
Ah, the shavings of Tung-Ak still haunt us, it seems. He touched the power of Heaven and went mad with it.
This is why the heart of a good Emperor is discipline. We wield great power, power corrupts like a black mold.
We must remain focused on our values, remind ourselves constantly for whom we rule, or choke on the spores of selfishness.
Now, have you what you require? Then channel your experience and the power of Myth. Call forth your new spell from the realms of nonexistence.
A grim Emperor indeed, one redolent with the scent of a painful old magic. Be judicious in its use.
Yeah, that's right, you cursed toads, and there's more earthquakes where that came from iff'n you don't keep your distance.
Wizard! 'Bout time I found you. Feelin' a bit like a chicken at a pizza party in this place: unwanted. You probably feel a bit like the pizza.
Now, far be it for me to tell you not to seek vengeance on those what wronged you. But maybe we can arm you better, huh? That's the spirit!
So I've been a-peckin' around the Cabal's old notes on this world, and we were very interested in something called the Scholomance.
Or more to the point, the strange cards that seem to read a person's soul and future, which originated in that hateful place.
What if we could recreate the idea, without all the evil, and merge it with our own magic to create a Spell? I think I might have an inkling as to how.
But spells need form and energy and identity. I think we can start with the latter by gathering up the Myths of Darkmoor.
There's a Hall of Records over yonder, see what you can find there.
